title: Migrate scheduler-adjacent tests off the deprecated LearningProgramRepository.instance singleton
why: This static singleton is exactly the 'global/static mutable singleton' SM-7 prohibits, and it has zero production (lib/) call sites — but 30+ test files across the suite (test/core/services/*, test/story_acceptance/*, test/features/tracks/*, test/features/onboarding/*, etc.) construct their fixtures via `LearningProgramRepository.instance` instead of overriding `learningProgramRepositoryProvider`. Because `test/` and `lib/` share one Dart package, Dart's default `deprecated_member_use` lint does not fire for same-package usage (only `deprecated_member_use_from_same_package` would, and it isn't enabled) — which is exactly why `flutter analyze: No issues found` coexists with 30+ live uses of a member explicitly marked for removal. The singleton can never actually be deleted while this fan-out exists, and every test using it is verifying against a construction path the app itself no longer uses.
recommendation: Migrate test fixtures to override learningProgramRepositoryProvider via ProviderContainer overrides instead of reading the singleton directly; once the fan-out is gone, delete the singleton entirely.
acceptance_criteria: New test code does not introduce further LearningProgramRepository.instance call sites.
Existing call sites tracked for migration (e.g. a DNI ticket) with a path to eventual deletion of the singleton.

corrections: Actual scope is 12 test files with 34 real .instance construction call sites, not '30+ test files' as stated — the finding conflated call-site count with file count. Substance unaffected.

Lines 69-70 quotes are exact; the singleton has zero real lib/ call sites (grep: only dartdoc [LearningProgramRepository.instance] references) and deprecated_member_use_from_same_package isn't enabled, so the SM-7 violation is real and undetected by tooling. However the 'why' claims '30+ test files' use LearningProgramRepository.instance directly — actual grep shows 11 files (33 total occurrences, one file alone has 13). Core violation, deprecation, and severity (P3) still hold; only the scale narrative is inflated ~3x.
